12.description: This item amends the Aspen Ridge Neighbourhood Concept Plan, reducing its size, adding multi-unit and residential care home sites, and rezoning land for new housing development.

chips.text: Superintendent Martin confirmed schools can accommodate the slight population increase.
Future residents will occupy 46 new lots to be serviced this year by DCAL Developments.
Future land use for the removed triangular parcel remains undetermined
Two individuals raised concerns about traffic, parking, and impact on low-density residential homes.
Construction of the Link Later linear park is slated to begin this year.

14.description: This item permits a six-story, high-density condominium building at 702 and 706 Victoria Avenue, increasing allowed height from four stories. It addresses an underserviced housing need for lock-and-leave units.

chips.text: Administration chose not to set specific parking rates in the agreement.
353 property owners within 150 meters of the site were notified.
Public comments raised concerns about local traffic and construction impacts.
Urban forestry reviewed the design for retention of mature trees.
Developer committed to not affecting any city boulevard trees.

13.description: Saskatoon will allow more garden and garage suites, including two-story options with lane access. It also permits up to six units on corner lots in Transit Development Areas as a discretionary use.

chips.text: Developers may access CMHC funding for projects with five or more units.
Administration noted a progression from discretionary to permitted use for these types of suites.
Public comments raised concerns about traffic, parking, and servicing.

11.description: The Municipal Planning Commission approved using its $7,000 budget for members to attend planning conferences in 2026, encouraging new members to participate.

chips.text: A member offered to cover their own flight costs to save budget.
